derivation: from a compound of G1223 (διά) and G3539 (νοιέω);
def: something thought through, i.e. a sentiment

occurrences.text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
